definitions.basic_dilution_pct: newly issued common shares / point-in-time pre-event same-class shares outstanding * 100; weighted shares are fallback only
definitions.basic_dilution_pct_weighted_sensitivity: newly issued common shares / Massive weighted shares outstanding * 100; robustness field, not primary bin
definitions.fully_diluted_overhang_pct: (new common shares + explicitly quantified warrant/convertible shares) / pre-event weighted shares * 100
definitions.financing_market_cap_pct: reported/derived financing amount / point-in-time pre-event market cap * 100
definitions.float_shock_pct: reserved; not backfilled with today's float because historical PIT float is unavailable
